"""Offline public-source and task-submission boundaries; no database/provider use."""
import gzip
import io
import tarfile
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
from uuid import uuid4

import httpx
from fastapi import HTTPException
from agentforge.contracts.tasks import TaskCreate
from agentforge.integrations.github_client import GitHubClient, GitHubError, unpack_archive, ResolvedRepository
from agentforge.api.routes_tasks import create_task
from agentforge.repositories.tasks import TaskNotFound

SHA = "a" * 40


def archive(entries):
    raw = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=raw, mode="w") as tar:
        for name, data, kind in entries:
            member = tarfile.TarInfo(name)
            member.type = kind
            member.size = len(data) if kind == tarfile.REGTYPE else 0
            member.linkname = "../../outside" if kind in (tarfile.SYMTYPE, tarfile.LNKTYPE) else ""
            tar.addfile(member, io.BytesIO(data) if kind == tarfile.REGTYPE else None)
    return gzip.compress(raw.getvalue())


class ArchiveTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_binary_source_is_preserved(self):
        value = unpack_archive(archive([("repo-sha/app.py", b"print('hi')\n", tarfile.REGTYPE),
            ("repo-sha/image.png", b"\x89PNG\0\xff", tarfile.REGTYPE)]))
        self.assertEqual(value["image.png"], b"\x89PNG\0\xff")
        self.assertEqual(set(value), {"app.py", "image.png"})

    def test_unsafe_archives_fail_as_a_whole(self):
        cases = [("root/../outside", tarfile.REGTYPE), ("root/link", tarfile.SYMTYPE),
            ("root/link", tarfile.LNKTYPE), ("root/fifo", tarfile.FIFOTYPE),
            ("root/.git/config", tarfile.REGTYPE), ("root/.env.local", tarfile.REGTYPE),
            ("root/.ssh/config", tarfile.REGTYPE), ("root/a\\b", tarfile.REGTYPE)]
        for name, kind in cases:
            with self.subTest(name=name, kind=kind), self.assertRaises(GitHubError):
                unpack_archive(archive([("root/ok", b"ok", tarfile.REGTYPE), (name, b"bad", kind)]))

    def test_collisions_and_limits_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(GitHubError):
            unpack_archive(archive([("root/A", b"1", tarfile.REGTYPE), ("root/a", b"2", tarfile.REGTYPE)]))
        with self.assertRaises(GitHubError):
            unpack_archive(archive([("root/file", b"x" * 1_000_001, tarfile.REGTYPE)]))
        with self.assertRaises(GitHubError):
            unpack_archive(archive([("root/a", b"1", tarfile.REGTYPE), ("root/a/b", b"2", tarfile.REGTYPE)]))
        with patch("agentforge.integrations.github_client.MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES", 1000), self.assertRaises(GitHubError):
            unpack_archive(gzip.compress(b"x" * 1001))
        with patch("agentforge.integrations.github_client.MAX_FILES", 1), self.assertRaises(GitHubError):
            unpack_archive(archive([("root/a", b"1", tarfile.REGTYPE), ("root/b", b"2", tarfile.REGTYPE)]))


class PublicClientTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_pinned_public_snapshot_no_credentials_and_official_hosts(self):
        seen = []
        async def respond(request):
            seen.append(request)
            if request.url.host == "codeload.github.com":
                return httpx.Response(200, content=archive([("repo-sha/a", b"abc", tarfile.REGTYPE)]))
            if "/commits/" in request.url.path:
                return httpx.Response(200, json={"sha": SHA})
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"private": False, "full_name": "owner/repo", "default_branch": "main"})
        result = await GitHubClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(respond)).snapshot("owner/repo", SHA)
        self.assertEqual(result.files, {"a": b"abc"})
        self.assertEqual(result.commit_sha, SHA)
        self.assertTrue(all("authorization" not in request.headers and "cookie" not in request.headers for request in seen))
        self.assertEqual({request.url.host for request in seen}, {"api.github.com", "codeload.github.com"})

    async def test_private_redirect_and_invalid_slug_rejected(self):
        for status, payload in [(200, {"private": True}), (302, {})]:
            requests = []
            def respond(request):

"""Complete-line, UTF-8-byte-bounded read pages for untrusted source text."""

MAX_READ_BYTES = 10_000
MAX_READ_LINES = 200


def read_lines(text: str, *, line_start: int = 1, max_lines: int = MAX_READ_LINES) -> dict:
    if isinstance(line_start, bool) or not isinstance(line_start, int) or line_start < 1:
        raise ValueError("invalid_read_line_start")
    if isinstance(max_lines, bool) or not isinstance(max_lines, int) or not 1 <= max_lines <= MAX_READ_LINES:
        raise ValueError("invalid_read_max_lines")
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    total = len(lines)
    if line_start > total + 1:
        raise ValueError("read_line_start_out_of_range")
    selected: list[str] = []
    byte_size = 0
    cursor = line_start - 1
    for line in lines[cursor:cursor + max_lines]:
        size = len(line.encode("utf-8"))
        if size > MAX_READ_BYTES:
            if not selected:
                # No partial line cursor exists: fail explicitly so retries do
                # not loop on a page that can never advance past this line.
                raise ValueError("read_line_exceeds_10000_byte_limit")
            break
        if byte_size + size > MAX_READ_BYTES:
            break
        selected.append(line)
        byte_size += size
        cursor += 1
    has_more = cursor < total
    return {"content": "".join(selected), "line_start": line_start,
            "total_lines": total, "next_line": cursor + 1 if has_more else None,
            "has_more": has_more, "truncated": has_more}

"""Read pages expose file tails without partial UTF-8 lines or provider calls."""
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace
from uuid import uuid4

from pydantic import TypeAdapter, ValidationError
from agentforge.tools.catalog import ToolCatalog
from agentforge.tools.contracts import RepoFileArgs, SandboxReadArgs, SandboxWriteArgs, ToolRequest

from agentforge.tools.sandbox_files import register_sandbox_files
from agentforge.tools.text_ranges import read_lines


class RangeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pagination_reassembles_exact_text(self):
        text = "".join(f"line {number}\n" for number in range(1, 502))
        cursor, chunks = 1, []
        while cursor is not None:
            page = read_lines(text, line_start=cursor)
            self.assertLessEqual(len(page["content"].encode()), 10000)
            self.assertEqual(page["total_lines"], 501)
            chunks.append(page["content"])
            cursor = page["next_line"]
        self.assertEqual("".join(chunks), text)
        self.assertFalse(page["truncated"])

    def test_byte_limit_applies_to_utf8_and_cursor_advances(self):
        line = "é" * 2499 + "\n"
        page = read_lines(line * 4)
        self.assertEqual(page["content"], line * 2)
        self.assertEqual(page["next_line"], 3)
        self.assertTrue(page["has_more"])
        self.assertLessEqual(len(page["content"].encode()), 10000)
        self.assertEqual(read_lines(line * 4, line_start=3)["content"], line * 2)

    def test_overlong_line_fails_explicitly(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "read_line_exceeds_10000_byte_limit"):
            read_lines("é" * 5001)
        page = read_lines("short\n" + "x" * 10001)
        self.assertEqual(page["next_line"], 2)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "read_line_exceeds_10000_byte_limit"):
            read_lines("short\n" + "x" * 10001, line_start=page["next_line"])

    def test_empty_file_final_line_and_bad_ranges(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_lines("")["total_lines"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(read_lines("a\nb", line_start=2)["content"], "b")
        self.assertIsNone(read_lines("a\nb", line_start=3)["next_line"])
        for kwargs in ({"line_start": 0}, {"line_start": True}, {"line_start": 4}, {"max_lines": 201}):
            with self.subTest(kwargs=kwargs), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                read_lines("a\nb", **kwargs)

    def test_read_schema_defaults_and_write_schema_stays_narrow(self):
        repo = RepoFileArgs(repo_id="owner/repo", ref="a" * 40, path="app.py")
        self.assertEqual((repo.line_start, repo.max_lines), (1, 200))
        request = TypeAdapter(ToolRequest).validate_python({"name": "read_sandbox_file", "args": {
            "sandbox_id": "session", "path": "app.py", "line_start": 201, "max_lines": 50}})
        self.assertIsInstance(request.args, SandboxReadArgs)
